style_anchor_suffix: cinematic epic fantasy, sweeping camera with twists and lateral sweeps left and right, shallow depth of field, 35mm anamorphic lens, rich color grading, high detail, dreamlike atmosphere, no readable text or logos

shots.prompt: Dynamic aerial flythrough weaving left and right through towering clouds, camera banking and twisting as it weaves between massive floating islands, each island a surreal office world with people sitting at desks, computers piled high, stacks of files and old filing cabinets teetering at the edges, papers drifting in the wind, the camera swoops and curves dramatically side to side through the chaos, then breaks free above the cloud line into open sky as a magnificent golden sunrise floods the horizon, warm amber and rose light, calm resolved arrival
